events.title: PSBS Biak Numfor vs PSIM Yogyakarta
events.dataContent:
PSBS Biak Numfor vs PSIM Yogyakarta: Live Stream & Watch Online

As the Indonesia - Super League heads into its critical matchday, all eyes will be on the clash between PSBS Biak Numfor and PSIM Yogyakarta. Both teams have encountered differing fortunes this season, making this match not only a fixture vital for points but also an important moment to swing momentum in their favor. With PSBS striving to climb the league standings and PSIM aiming to solidify their position, this encounter promises to provide plenty of drama and excitement. Kick-off: 27.02.2026, 13:30 UTC / 16:30 MSK
Stadium: Gelora Cenderawasih Stadium
Competition: Indonesia - Super League

Match Preview

PSBS Biak Numfor comes into this match struggling to find consistency, currently sitting near the bottom of the league table. They have had a challenging season, with a mix of draws and losses in their recent fixtures. With the pressure mounting on the players to secure points, manager Mustaqim must find a way to rally his troops and make a statement against a strong opponent. On the other side, PSIM Yogyakarta has enjoyed a more successful season thus far and is looking to capitalize on their momentum. Their recent performances have shown strength in both defense and attack, a testament to manager Seto Nurdiyantoro's strategic setup. In terms of injuries, both teams face challenges. PSBS will be without key mid-fielder Dimas, who has been sidelined due to an ankle injury. Meanwhile, PSIM Yogyakarta will miss their top scorer, Rahmat. This could greatly influence the tactical preparations for both teams as they head into a highly competitive environment.

Team Form and Analysis

PSBS Biak Numfor

PSBS Biak Numfor has shown vulnerability in their defensive structure, often leading to goals conceded. The side has struggled to find the back of the net consistently, which has compounded their troubles this season. Their current strategy seems to focus on counter-attacks, but with the absence of Dimas, creativity in the midfield will be crucial. Key players like forward Silva will need to step up their game and capitalize on any opportunity given to them if they are to change their fortunes for the better.

PSIM Yogyakarta

PSIM Yogyakarta's recent form has given them a boost in confidence. With a solid defense plus an attacking line that has performed well collectively, they present a challenging opponent for anyone in the league. Led by their experienced captain, the team will be looking to control possession and apply pressure to the Biak Numfor defense. Though they will miss the services of Rahmat, the depth in their squad should allow them to adjust without a significant drop in quality.

Predicted Starting Lineups

  • PSBS Biak Numfor:
    • Goalkeeper: Andri
    • Defenders: Joni, Hardi, Selamet, Supriyadi
    • Midfielders: Leman, Iskan, Tamsil
    • Forwards: Silva, Heru, Dedi
  • PSIM Yogyakarta:
    • Goalkeeper: Rudi
    • Defenders: Purwanto, Budi, Haris, Agung
    • Midfielders: Agus, Zaenal, Iqbal
    • Forwards: Roni, Sudirman, Adi

Match Prediction

  • Main Prediction: PSIM Yogyakarta to Win
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals
PSIM Yogyakarta has shown resilience and quality throughout the season, making them favorites against PSBS Biak Numfor. However, given the necessity for both teams to tighten their defenses, a low-scoring affair may also be on the cards. Expect a hard-fought battle as each side looks to assert dominance in the league.
